content: Sonadan Sewese Depit
Depit eri tangasang Naiod, nan Rama, tangalahng rehn Sonadan oh ndaiong, “Dahme I wiadahr? Dihp da me I dipkidahr? Sapwung da me I wiahiong omw pahpao me kahrehiong eh men kemeiehla?”

Sonadan ahpw sapeng, nda, “Ke dehr perki mehkot, ke sohte pahn mehla! Ei pahpao kin mahsanihong ie mehkoaros me e kin ketin wiahda, me kesempwal oh sohte kesempwal, oh e sohte pahn ekihsang ie mewet. Soh! E sohte kak!”

A Depit sapeng, ketihtihki, “Omw pahpao inenen mwahngih mwahu duwen omw poakepoake ie, oh e koasoanehdi nan kupwure me e sohte pahn kasalehiong uhk dahme e kupwukupwurehiong ie, pwe e de kauweiukala. I kakete kahukihla ni mwaren KAUN-O me I sohte dohsang ei pahn mehla.”
Sonadan ahpw sapeng, nda, “Eri, I pahn wia mehkoaros me ke anahne.”

Depit eri sapeng, nda, “Kilang, lakapw iei rahn Sarawien Maram Pwul, rahn me I kin epwehnki iang nanmwarki ketidiong nin tehpel. Eri, ma ke mweidohng ie, I pahn kolahng rukula nansapw lel nin soutik en pali.

Ma omw pahpao pahn tehkada me I sohte iang mihmi nin tehpelo, a menlau padahkihong me I pekihda rehmw mweimwei pwe I en patolahng mahs ni imweio nan Pedleem, pwe ih ahnsoun at peneinei ar kin wia at sarawien meirong nan sounpar koaros.
Eri, ma e pahn mahsanih, “Me mwahu,” eri, I pahn nsenamwahu oh pitla. A ma e engiengda, ke pahn esehki me e ketin koasoanehdi en kemeiehla.
Menlau kapwaiada ei pekipeket, oh kapwaiada inou sarawi me ke wiahiong ie. Ahpw ma I dipadahr, eri a, ke nek pein kemeiehla. Dahme omw pahpao me pahn kemehkiniehla?”
Sonadan ahpw sapeng, nda, “Ke dehr lemeleme soahngen. Ma I uhdahn ese me ei pahpao koasoanehdi nan kupwure en kemeiukala, I uhdahn pahn kairehkin uhk.”
Depit eri idek reh, “A ihs me pahn kairehkin ie, ma omw pahpao sapeng uhk nan eh engieng?”
Sonadan ahpw sapeng Depit, nda, “Kita kohieila nan mohso.” Ira eri kohieila,

oh Sonadan ndahng Depit, “KAUN-O, Koht en Israel, en ketin wia ata sounkadehde, lakapw, ni soangen ahnsou wet, oh pil pali, I pahn idek rehn ei pahpao. Ma e pahn mwomwen kadek ong uhk, I pahn pakairkihong uhk.

A ma e kupwukupwure en kauweiukala, KAUN-O en ketin kemeiehla ma I sohte pahn pakairkihong uhk oh kadaralahng uhk wasa me ke kak rukula ie. KAUN-O en ketiket rehmw duwehte eh kin ketin ieiang ei pahpao!
A ma I pahn momourte, menlau kapwaiada omw inouwen oh loalopwoatohng ie; ahpw ma I mehla,
kadekohng ei peineinei ahnsou koaros. Eri, ahnsou me KAUN-O pahn ketin kamwomwala douluhl omwi imwintihti kan koaros,
ata inou wet pahn poatopoatte, sohte pahn ohla. Ma e pahn ohla, KAUN-O pahn ketin kalokeiuk.”
Sonadan eri pwurehng koangngoangehki Depit en pwurehng wiahda inoun limpoak ong ih, pwe Sonadan poakepoake mehlel Depit duwehte eh kin poakohng pein eh mour.
Sonadan eri ndaiong Depit, “Lakapw, iei rahn Sarawien Maram Pwul; oh ma ke sohte iang mi wasao, re pahn tehkada omw sohte iang kasarawio.
Oh pil pali, ma ke sohte iang, re pahn inenen tehkada. Eri, kohwei wasaohte me ke rukula ie mahso, oh rukula palio kasukasuk en takaio.
Eri, I ahpw pahn kadaralahng kanengen kesik ketieu silipwoat, mwomwen me I songosong kaskih mehkot.

I ahpw pahn ndaiong ei ladu en kohla rapahkihdo. Eri, ma I ndaiong, ‘Kilang, pwe kanengen kesik ketieu ko mihmi palihdo sang uhk; ale oh wahdo;’ met wehwehki me ke pitlahr. Eri, ke pahn kohdo rehi. Ke dehpa perki mehkot.
A ma I ndaiong, ‘Kanengen kesik ketieu ko mihmi palihla sang uhk;’ eri kohkohwei, pwe iei kupwur en KAUN-O men.
A duwen inou me kita wiahda nanpwungata, KAUN-O pahn ketin kupwure pwe kita en kin dadaurete.”
Depit eri rukula nansapwo. Ni ahnsoun Sarawien Maram Pwulo, Nanmwarki Sohl ahpw ketido
oh ketidiong nan mwoale limwahn dihdo. Apner mwohd limwah, a Sonadan mwohd mwowe palio tehpelo. A sohte aramas nan dewen Depito.
Ahpw Sohl sohte mahsanih mehkot rahno, pwe e kupwukupwure, “Ele mehkot wiawihong Depit oh e sohte mwakelekeliong sarawiet.”
Mandahn rahno, mwurin Sarawien Maram Pwulo, dewen Depito pil tetehnte. Iei me Sohl keinemwe rehn Sonadan, “Dahme Depit sohte iangki kamadipw wet aio oh rahnwet?”
A Sonadan sapeng, patohwan, “Ahki e pekihda rehi en patolahng Pedleem.

E patohwanohng ie, ‘Menlau mweidohng ie, pwe at peneinei pahn wia kasarawihpen at meirong en pahr nan kanimwo, oh rieio koasoanehdi I en iang mi wasao. Eri, ma kowe uhdahn kompoakepahi, a mweidohng ie I en kohla oh tuhwong mahs kisehi ko.’ Eri, ih kahrepen eh sohte mi nan dewe ni sapwellimomwi tehpelet.”
Sohl eri engiengda kowahlap pahn Sonadan oh mahsanihong, “Ia uwen kahngohdi oh soaloalopwoat en omw nohno! I esehte me ke kin uhpalihki Depit, iei me ke kauwehkilahr pein kowe oh pil eden omw nohno!
Eri, ke ese pwe nindokon Depit eh momour, ke sohte mwahn kak wiahla nanmwarkien wehiet. Ahnsou wette kohwei oh wahdo rehi wasaht, pwe e uhdahn pahn kamakamala.”
Sonadan eri sapeng, patohwan, “Dahme e pahn kamakamkihla? Sapwung da me e wiahda?”
Ni ahnsowohte Sohl doakoahki sapwellime ketieuo Sonadan pwe en kemehla. Sonadan ahpw esehkihda me eh pahpao koasoanedier nan kupwure me e pahn ketin kemehla Depit.

Sonadan eri uhda sang nin tehpelo, nan kapehde inenen lingeringer. Ihme e sohte mwahn mwengehki ni keriaun rahnen Sarawien Maram Pwulo. E inenen nsensuwedkihla Depit, pwehki eh pahpao e ketin kamwamwahlihala.
Nimenseng en mandahn rahno, Sonadan ahpw kohla rehn Depit nan mohso, duwen ara inoukipene. E ahpw kahrehda kisin pwutak kis.
Ih eri ndaiong kisin pwutako, “Ke pahn tangewei oh ale kanengen kesik ketieu kan me I pahn kadar.” Kisin pwutako eri tangala, a Sonadan kadar kanengen kesik ieu me pwupw palila sang.
Ni kisin pwutako eh lel wasa me kanengen kesik ketieuo pwupwudi ieo, Sonadan ahpw wering, nda, “E pwupwudi kaileweisang men!
Mwadang! Ke dehr uhdi!” Kisin pwutako rikada kanengen kesik ketieuo oh pwurodohng rehn Sonadan.
E ahpw sehse da wehwehn tiahko; a Sonadan oh Depit kelehpw me ese.
Sonadan eri kihong kisin pwutako nah dipwisoun mahwen ko oh ndaiong en kapwurehla nan kahnimwo.

Eri, mwurin kisin pwutako eh samwalahr, Depit ahpw kesihnenda palio kasukasuk en takaio. E ahpw poaridiong nanpwelo pak siluh. Ih oh Sonadan ahpw wie sengiseng oh emente metik mesen emen; en Depit eh nsensuwed inenen laudsang en Sonadan.

Sonadan eri ndaiong Depit, “Koht en ketin ieiang uhk. KAUN-O pahn ketin kupwure pwe kowe oh ngehi, oh kadaudokomw kan oh pil kadaudokei kan, kitail en kin dadaurete inou sarawi me kita kauwadahr nanpwungata.” Depit eri mwesel kohkohla, a Sonadan pwurala nan kahnimwo.
